ai_summary: Alkali Metals Limited's upcoming virtual AGM addresses routine business, including the adoption of FY25-26 financials and a ₹1 dividend declaration, alongside significant special resolutions for executive appointments. Key takeaways include the re-appointment of the Managing Director and appointment of an Executive Director with remarkably substantial remuneration packages, featuring high basic salaries, 10% annual increments, and a 5% profit commission for the MD. A notable red flag is the unclear term of appointment and an illegible HRA component for the Executive Director, raising transparency concerns about these material compensation proposals.
